name: brenn-surface-build
description: Build-time toolchain for surface processor assets: jco transpiles brenn:processor component-model artifacts into browser-loadable ES modules.
//type: The transpiled trees under dist/ are ES modules with no extension of their own to say so; declaring it here stops node from reparsing them as CommonJS first when a test loads one directly.
//pnpm: No dependency in this tree has an install-time build step, so none is allowed one. rules_js refuses to translate a lockfile that leaves the question unanswered; npm ignores the key.
